'''Cockroach soldiers''' are giant insects found exclusively in the [[Stronghold of Player Safety]]. As a [[free-to-play]] monster, they offer a very consistent method of making money. Additionally, they are the source of [[carapace]], used to craft [[carapace armour]].

==Combat strategies==
The cockroach soldiers (among other monsters) were updated with the introduction of [[Necromancy]] and have become more formidable opponents. However, players with 40+ Magic and using [[Revolution/Bars]] can still kill them fairly easily. They are not aggressive and only retaliate with melee. Their large size and the cramped layout of the dungeon means it is very easy to get them stuck and kill them from a [[safe spot]]. While it is possible to kill them with melee, the soldiers hit fairly often even through rune armour.

The rope on the stronghold's upper level provides easy access to the [[Edgeville]] bank, but can only be used from outside after climbing up from inside at least once.
